title: Federal Circuit order, Driscoll's Inc. v. California Berry Cultivars, No. 25-1747
source_name: United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit (via Justia)
summary: Order of 23 June 2025 dismissing appeal 25-1747 for lack of jurisdiction, because invalidity counterclaims remain pending in the district court, Eastern District of California case number 2:19-cv-00493. Driscoll's of Europe B.V. appears as a co-plaintiff. The patents at issue are strawberry patents.
why_it_matters: Confirms from the court record, rather than from a party's press release, that this dispute is a strawberry matter and remains unresolved. It also confirms the existence of the European Driscoll's entity.

reading.rationale: Procedural, and outside the blueberry scope.

monitoring.rationale: Only relevant if a blueberry patent dispute follows.
